review.tagline: Design skill with 24 commands and a detector for AI-generated frontends
review.summary: Impeccable installs a single /impeccable skill into AI coding tools, with 24 commands such as audit, critique, polish, typeset and live browser variant iteration. It writes PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md for project context, and ships 59 deterministic detector rules that run in a CLI and browser extension without an LLM or API key. Hooks flag common AI design tells on UI file edits in supported harnesses.
review.audience: Developers using AI coding agents who want better frontend design output
strengths: Supports many harnesses: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Grok Build, Hermes
59 deterministic detector rules run without an LLM or API key
Edit hooks surface design findings; Cursor blocks bad writes before they land
Several install paths: npx installer, Git submodule, plugin marketplace, manual copy
weaknesses: Native edit hooks are not available on every harness; Hermes and Veto get none
Roll API at impeccable.style is called when a new design starts; telemetry is opt-out
Downloads an engine binary into ~/.impeccable/bin/ on first run if not bundled
Codex and Grok Build need manual hook or folder trust approval after install
needs: Needs Node.js (only for npx installer), impeccable.style roll API
Models: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot
